d: A baseball game with the family should be about the action on the field, but what happens when the ads become part of the debate? Sydney Sweeney's Novig sports prediction ad has drawn criticism during the MLB playoffs, with Dodgers outfielder Alex Call asking broadcasters to pull it because children watch baseball with their parents. Rupha Ramani examines the debate that surely goes beyond one commercial and forces us to think about the role of broadcasters and what young fans see when they tune in.
